message.content:
**rs7412 (APOE ε2 allele) – European population frequency**

| Population (1000 Genomes) | Allele (C) frequency |
|---------------------------|----------------------|
| CEU (Utah residents, Northern & Western European ancestry) | ~0.15 |
| TSI (Toscani in Italy) | ~0.12 |
| IBS (Iberian population in Spain) | ~0.13 |
| FIN (Finnish) | ~0.10 |
| GBR (British) | ~0.14 |

**Overall estimate for “European” (combined 1000 Genomes European superpopulation)**  
≈ **0.13–0.15** (13–15 % of chromosomes carry the rs7412 C allele).

> **Key points**
> - rs7412 is one of the two SNPs that define the APOE ε2 allele (the other being rs429358).
> - The ε2 allele is relatively common in European ancestry groups, with frequencies ranging from ~10 % in Finns to ~15 % in Northern/Western Europeans.
> - Frequencies can vary by sub‑population and by study; the values above are taken from the 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 dataset.

**References**

1. 1000 Genomes Project Consortium. *A global reference for human genetic variation*. Nature 2015; 526:68–74.  
2. HapMap Project. *A haplotype map of the human genome*. Nature 2005; 437:1299–1320.  
3. Kunkle, B. W. et al. *Genetic meta‑analysis of Alzheimer’s disease*. Nat Genet 2019; 51:414–424. (provides APOE allele frequencies in European cohorts).

If you need the frequency for a specific European sub‑population or a more recent dataset (e.g., gnomAD v3.1), let me know!
